hero.eyebrow: Welcome to Fische & mehr in Vienna
hero.title:
Freshness
you can taste.
hero.subtitle: A wide selection of fresh, frozen and smoked fish, caviar and selected Russian and Eastern European delicacies. Quality, taste and personal preparation are at the heart of what we do.

product.title:
A wide choice
for every taste.
product.body:
Our fish range includes carp, gilt-head bream (dorade), sea bass (branzino), trout and salmon – whole or as fillet, depending on availability.

We also carry tuna fillet and tuna steaks, tilapia fillet, cod fillet, pike-perch fillet, silver carp, plaice fillet and hake (Oslić). Depending on the type of fish and availability, we offer them fresh or frozen.

cta.title: בואו לבקר.
cta.body: שאלות על המבחר של היום? התקשרו או כתבו לנו בוואטסאפ. נשמח לעזור.

smoked.title:
Aromatic, hearty
and full of flavour.
smoked.body: Discover our selection of smoked fish and fillets. Ideal for a snack, for breakfast, for guests or simply to enjoy.

caviar.title:
A special delicacy
for special moments.
caviar.body: We carry high-quality salmon caviar with a fine taste and the best quality – perfect for enjoying, serving and for festive occasions.

closing.title:
Fish, delicacies & personal service
in one place.
closing.body: Whether for everyday meals, a family celebration or a special occasion – discover our varied range and have your fish prepared just the way you want it.
closing.cta: Visit us in Vienna – we look forward to seeing you!

hero.title: מה מונח אצלנו על הדלפק.
hero.intro: Fresh, frozen and smoked fish, salmon caviar and selected delicacies. Ask in the shop, by phone or on WhatsApp what's in today.

v1.title: Freshness

categories.title:
Far more
than just fish.
categories.intro: Discover a wide selection of popular specialities: pickled cucumbers, tomatoes, peppers, cabbage, mushrooms and garlic, plus courgette purée, Georgian-style peppers and mild aubergines with peppers. You'll also find classics such as Russian condensed milk, canned cod liver, sprats and other selected specialities. For everyone who loves traditional flavours – there's plenty here to delight.

items.q: אפשר להזמין דגים או מגשי דגים מראש?
items.a: Yes – best in the shop or by phone, in good time. We prepare your fish to your wishes and put fish platters together for you.

Salmon caviar and Russian and Eastern European delicacies: pickled cucumbers, tomatoes, peppers, cabbage, mushrooms and garlic, courgette purée, Georgian-style peppers, aubergines with peppers, Russian condensed milk, canned cod liver, sprats and more.
כן. אנחנו מעבדים את הדג שלכם בחנות לפי בקשתכם ואורזים אותו טרי בוואקום עבורכם.
שני עד שישי מ-08:30 עד 17:30. שבת וראשון סגור.
Glockengasse 22, 1020 וינה — כמה דקות הליכה מתחנת Taborstraße, נגיש בקלות בתחבורה ציבורית.
כרגע אין חנות מקוונת. בואו לבקר או התקשרו — נשמח לספר לכם מה טרי היום.
